steps.name: Check benchmark contracts and repository gates
Build both arms with one recorded toolchain
Check time admission before local-scale allocation
Prepare ephemeral runner disk when needed
Paired v1 commands with isolated observers

limitations: The 1500s pressure allowance is whole-step, not a demonstrated per-worker upper bound; 1800s command cap is not assured at full-scale 512 MiB.
Full 1GiB A/A one-pair 16.75% spread and cross-VM scaling are not causal estimates.
512MiB full-scale capacity remains unmeasured; no cap increases, fixture reduction, or gate waivers.
